title: A single control in the table header expands or collapses all technician rows with the correct accessible names
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Technician Utilization report with several technician rows loaded.
custom_steps:
1. Find the expand/collapse-all control in the table's header row (in the Technician column) and read its accessible name.
2. With all rows collapsed, activate it.
3. Collapse ONE row manually, then activate the control again.
4. With every row expanded, activate it once more.
custom_expected:
1. The control lives in the table's header row (Technician column) - NOT in the toolbar action cluster.
2. If ANY row is collapsed, activating it expands ALL rows; only when EVERY row is already expanded does it collapse all rows (so step 3's activation re-expands the one collapsed row).
3. Its accessible name reflects the next action: "Expand all technicians" when it will expand, "Collapse all technicians" when every row is already expanded.
4. It is keyboard-focusable, toggles on Enter/Space, and exposes its state to assistive technology.
